name: FLIP＊FLOP ~RAMBLING OVERRUN~
source:
Together with me, we shall go to a new world.

"Yes, senpai, I have decided to make you mine."

A technological cutting-edge city, Shinsui.
Everything about life there is exciting, with new discoveries and inventions popping out every day.

In that city, lives a genius girl, Tsukigaoka Ran.

Her clear-headness might be something we call genius, but nobody understands her.
Even Tsukigaoka Ran herself, does not understand what kind of being she is.

No, she should've known. What is she.
But, she doesn't really know. The feelings of love and the like that begins to sprout within her.

Tsukugaoka Ran's feelings of love. Another new thing born here in Shinsui.
It may be the single most exciting thing to witness with your own eyes.

[Translated from the [url=https://fanzagames-digination.com/flipflop_ran/]official website[/url]]
translation:
和我一起，我们去往新世界吧。

“是的，前辈。我已经决定要让你成为我的人。”

Shinsui是一座技术尖端的城市。
那里的生活处处令人兴奋，每天都有新发现和新发明涌现。

这座城市里住着一位天才少女Tsukigaoka Ran。

她头脑清晰，也许这就是所谓的天才，但没人理解她。
就连Tsukigaoka Ran本人，也不明白自己究竟是什么样的存在。

不，她本该知道自己是什么。
但她其实并不清楚，那些在心中开始萌生的爱恋之情，以及类似的种种心绪。

Tsukigaoka Ran的爱恋之情，是在Shinsui诞生的另一种新事物。
亲眼见证这一切，或许是最令人兴奋的事。

[译自[url=https://fanzagames-digination.com/flipflop_ran/]official website[/url]]
